name: Houchi Yukina
source:
Typical gyaru type of girl with sharp tongue and strong attitude. However she does have a rich boyfriend whom she shows her sweet side to.

[spoiler]Due to her past trauma of being treated badly by her violent father she grew up to be stubborn and unyielding to adult men. Following her hatred she takes part in compensated dating scam and sees it as justice.[/spoiler]
